user.title: Xiaomi Weather
user.description: Where would you like to see the weather?

reconfigure.title: Update weather location
reconfigure.description: Current city code: {city_id}. Choose how to enter the location. Previous coordinates will not be added to your inputs. To change cities, add a new integration.

zone.title: Use Home or another zone
zone.description: Choose Home or another zone. Its coordinates are captured now; later zone changes require reconfiguration. The service name defaults to the zone name and can be edited on the review screen.

data_description.city_id: Leave empty to match a city from the coordinates, or specify a city name/code.

search.title: Search for a city
search.description: Enter a city name or code, such as 北京, 朝阳区, or 101010100. Review the matches and select a city on the next screen.

data_description.latitude: Leave empty to use the city coordinates. To specify a location, enter both latitude and longitude.

coordinates.title: Enter coordinates
coordinates.description: Enter the coordinates of the location. A city will be matched automatically.

data_description.city_id: Leave empty to match a city from the coordinates, or specify a city name/code.

city.title: Choose a city
city.description: Review the matched region and select a city. Check the region and code even when there is only one result.

confirm.title: Review location

data_description.edit_location: Select and submit to return to the location menu without saving.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to fetch weather right now. Your location and name have been kept. Retry, or choose a different location.
error.coordinates_required: Provide both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
error.invalid_city_id: Use a nine-digit city code starting with 101, or enter a city name.
error.city_not_found: No supported mainland China city found. Check the input or try a more specific name.
error.different_city: The resolved city differs from the existing city. Add a new integration for it.
error.invalid_zone: The selected zone is missing or has invalid coordinates. Select a valid zone.
error.lookup_failed: Unable to look up the city right now. Your inputs have been kept; please try again.
